_definition: Inventario de categorias board/line de Combined: por cada categoria (id=slug), n_goals y objectives[] ({goal, range, progression, …}). Limits board/line → Combined.limits. Icons/tooltip → goal_icons / goals_referencia. orden = 1..N alfa por id.
_note: Campos grupo: id, orden, n_goals, objectives[]. Cabecera: n_goals = distintas; n_goals_1_cat = 1 board + 1 line (misma cat aquí); n_goals_2_cats = 2 board + 2 line (2 cats). No debería haber 1/3/5 tags board+line. objectives desactivados llevan disabled=true. Regenerar: python Files/export_combined_meta.py lineas
